description: Hi! I’m Alex, a student passionate about space, CS, AI, and innovation. After competing in NASA Space Apps in Baku (2024, 2nd nationally & People’s Choice) and Mountain View, CA (2025), I’m leading Quantum Stack; a team of curious minds combining AI, coding, science, research, design, and storytelling. We’re looking for motivated teammates ready to experiment, collaborate, and think beyond the obvious. Join us! 🚀
